data.name: Rider Valkyries
data.detailed_description:
• Extreme Close-Quarter Racing

Not fast enough?
Then get closer.

Between heat-soaked coastal highways and neon-lit night districts,
motorcycle girls weave through the city in tight races and close combat.

Sparks burst between steel and asphalt.
The closer the distance, the faster the heartbeat.

A tribute to classic arcade-style street racing,
enhanced with open-world freedom and modern combat systems
for a wilder, more immersive riding experience.

• Stylized Combat System

Deliver precise strikes at high speed.
Control the rhythm at the edge of danger.

Melee Gear: chains, batons, impact weapons
Tactical Devices: electric and restraint-based equipment
Ranged Weapons: light firearms and tactical shooting
Legendary Arms: iconic cold weapons inspired by Eastern aesthetics

Each weapon features unique animations and feedback.
Combat is sharp, direct, and intense.

Full voice support in Chinese, English, Japanese, and Korean.
Every breath and laugh is brought vividly to life.

• Vast Open World

A coastal metropolis where desire and speed intertwine,
spanning over 100 square kilometers.

Downtown — dazzling lights, restless nights.
Beaches — blazing sun, untamed freedom.
Industrial zones — hidden currents of power.
Suburbs and mountains — secrets and danger await.

Explore freely, enter races, clash with rival factions, uncover hidden stories and special interactions.

Planes, yachts, track challenges, exclusive party venues…
Every corner of the city holds a story.

• Distinctive Motorcycle Girls

From different worlds, united by speed:

Street delinquent
Pop idol rider
Calm mechanical engineer
Gifted young racer
Mysterious dark queen
EDM culture DJ
Laid-back free spirit
Intelligence agent
Heir to Eastern swordsmanship
Proud noble lady

They are more than teammates.
Between fierce battles and late-night conversations,
your distance slowly changes.

Fully voiced performances bring emotion, tension, and subtle sparks to life.

• Multi-Route Relationships & Fate

As the club’s strategist in the shadows,
you deploy riders, plan operations, and expand influence.

They race on the front lines.
You control the bigger picture from the dark.

Build deep bonds, unlock exclusive storylines and hidden events.

Some choices are about profit.
Others are about trust and dependence.

One girl seeks the truth behind her father’s death—
an accident that may be closer to you than she believes.

When the truth approaches,
will she embrace you… or cast you into the abyss?

Your decisions will shape destiny.

• Desire & Bonds

Moto Maidens contains mature themes and adult atmosphere.

It is not only about speed and combat,
but about emotions swaying between desire and danger.

In this city,
it’s not only the machines that draw close—
but hearts.

data.short_description: is an anime-style open-world game blending urban fantasy, motorcycle racing, and multi-character storytelling. In a neon-soaked coastal city, roaring engines echo racing hearts. Ride alongside captivating biker girls. Beyond speed lies desire, trust, and choice.
data.supported_languages:
English*, Simplified Chinese*, Japanese*, Korean*, French, German, Russian, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Spanish - Latin America
*languages with full audio support
